title: 第二十五章  射杀祸首事后拂衣第二十六章  周家反应祸水东引
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: 河西，周府。
周良玉端坐书桌前，一盏油灯照亮了整个房间。
“气沉丹田守中定，意随息走贯周身，心如止水神自聚，劲发千钧在一瞬......”
他口中喃喃自语着。
这是沧海武馆授予真传弟子的武学，一旦入门可以比寻常武人更容易调动体内气血，游走周天，从而获得更加迅速的修行速度。
周良玉突然心生感应，下意识看向门口。
他站起身，打开房门，朝外望去。
小院内，景色一如既往。
两名护卫手中拿着灯笼照明，缓缓从拱门走来。
看到周良玉，顿时一愣：
“少爷，是有什么事情吗？”
周良玉目光扫过周围，并没有发现任何异常。
他摇了摇头：
“夜里气闷，出来喘口气。今夜有没有事情发生？”
两名护卫对视一眼，否认道：
“今夜一切安好，就碰见只野猫游荡，已经被我们赶出去了。”
周良玉点了点头，
“那就辛苦两位了。”
护卫们连忙回应：
“分内之事。”
周良玉不再多说，关上房门。
不多时，房内暗了下来。
两名护卫见状，也不多做停留，径直朝着其他方向巡逻而去。
途中，一名护卫不由感慨：
“周少爷为人真不错啊，就算对我们这些护卫也是这么客气。”
“那是，周少爷每逢佳节，还会给我们这些下人多点赏钱。”
另一名护卫接话道。
两人说着，脚步逐渐远去。
片刻后。
一道人影骤现。
陆川若有所思。
这周家少爷，居然先前在三重山下碰到过，正是那位沧海武馆真传。
观他行为处事，倒不像是周老爷的种。
果然就算是只老鼠，窝里说不定也能生出只金毛鼠。
陆川并没有忘记正事，步伐一动，他便离开了这个小院。
他一路探查过数个小院，最终在周府中间的小院停下。
这是周府中最为豪华的小院，种着不少精心修剪的盆栽。
院中还有一个小湖，数把摇椅坐落小院各处。
显然这里是经过精心布置的。
能花这么大的本钱，只说明了一点，这里是周家老爷所在。
陆川放轻步伐，朝着房屋摸索而去。
刚刚靠近，对话声传来：
content_en:
Hexi, Zhou Mansion.
Zhou Liangyu sat in front of his desk, an oil lamp lighting up the whole room.
"The Qi sinks in the Dantian and maintains concentration. The mind moves throughout the whole body with the breath. The heart is as calm as water and the spirit gathers itself. The energy is at a critical moment..."
He muttered to himself.
This is a martial art given to true disciples by the Canghai Martial Arts School. Once you get started, you can mobilize the energy and blood in your body more easily than ordinary martial artists, and travel around the world, thereby achieving a faster cultivation speed.
"Huh?"
Zhou Liangyu suddenly felt something in his heart and subconsciously looked at the door.
He stood up, opened the door, and looked outside.
In the small courtyard, the scenery remains the same.
The two guards held lanterns in their hands for lighting and walked slowly through the arch.
Seeing Zhou Liangyu, he was stunned:
"Master, what's the matter?"
Zhou Liangyu glanced around and found nothing unusual.
He shook his head:
"I feel stuffy at night. Come out and take a breather. Is anything going to happen tonight?"
The two guards looked at each other and denied:
"Everything is fine tonight, but we saw a wild cat wandering around, and we have driven it out."
Zhou Liangyu nodded,
"Then you two have worked hard."
The guards responded quickly:
"It's your job."
Zhou Liangyu said no more and closed the door.
After a while, the room became dark.
When the two guards saw this, they didn't stop much and went straight to patrol in other directions.
On the way, a guard couldn't help but sigh:
"Master Zhou is such a nice person, he is so polite even to us guards."
"That's right, Master Zhou will give more rewards to us servants during festive seasons."
Another guard answered.
The two of them talked and gradually walked away.
After a while.
A figure suddenly appeared.
Lu Chuan was thoughtful.
This young master of the Zhou family actually met him before at the foot of Sanchong Mountain. It was the true master of the Canghai Martial Arts School.
Judging from his behavior, he doesn't look like Mr. Zhou.
Sure enough, even if it was a mouse, a golden mouse might be born in the nest.
Lu Chuan did not forget the business, and he left the small courtyard with a quick step.
He explored several small courtyards along the way, and finally stopped at the small courtyard in the middle of Zhou Mansion.
This is the most luxurious courtyard in Zhou Mansion, with many carefully trimmed potted plants planted there.
There is also a small lake in the courtyard, and several rocking chairs are located throughout the courtyard.
It's obviously been carefully arranged here.
Being able to spend such a large amount of money only shows that this is where the master of the Zhou family lives.
Lu Chuan walked lightly and groped towards the house.
Just as we got closer, a voice came from the conversation:
